title: More Sinkholes
description: Makes sinkholes (weirdness< -1.8) a little more common
body:
Sinkholes are pretty cool, but so rare that most worlds don't have them within reasonable distance from spawn, meaning you need specific seeds to find them. This datapack bumps up their commonness so they will be findable, even on existing worlds (approx every 2k or so blocks). It also has the side effect of making mountain bowls more common.


Tested successfully with mods that affect generation eg [Biomes O Plenty](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomes-o-plenty) or [Regions Unexplored](https://modrinth.com/mod/regions-unexplored).

Works best with [Sinkhole Restorer](https://modrinth.com/mod/sinkhole-restorer).
